QuestInfo.name: Team Training is Fun! (Party)
QuestInfo.0: They say if you train in a group, the journey becomes more fun for everyone. Get details from Power B. Fore.
QuestInfo.1: They say if you train in a group, the journey becomes more fun for everyone. The journey is long, but if you work with others, you'll all be able to achieve your goals!
QuestInfo.2: You were able to successfully complete Power B. Fore's training sessions.
QuestInfo.summary: Party hunting allows you to complete quests much more quickly than attempting them alone.

0.0: Hey, are you familiar with the concept of #bParty Hunting#k? It's when you venture out to hunt as a group, with the mentality of 'all for one and one for all.' If you train in a party, it will allow you to overcome some tough obstacles.\r\n
0.1: This training session will not be easy for you to complete by yourself, but if you team up and train in a party, it should be a piece of cake. Do you want to try it?

yes.0: Alright then. Defeat #b200 Pigs#k. It will not be easy, so try joining a party and hunting with others!

no.0: Teamwork is one of the most important aspects of your combat abilities, one that you need to nurture in order to become an excellent adventurer.

1.0: Great work there. Don't forget, hunting as a party may help you complete your quests much faster.

mob.0: I don't think you have defeated all those Pigs yet.
